Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2412.03205v4. University-problem sourcing/manual curation and saturation/visual-cell limitations establish data/evaluation workflow. Actual header spells out LargeLanguageModels; it is one U-MATH arXiv work, not a new family. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The authors note incomplete coverage of advanced mathematics, saturation of text-only questions, limited visual coverage and LLM-judge errors; visual problems are excluded from the meta-evaluation.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

U-MATH sources expert-crafted problems from ongoing university courses, filters short-solution, multiple-choice and calculator-use problems, and uses small-model solution rates followed by expert review to select challenging problems.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

U-MATH has 1, 100 problems across six subjects, including 900 text-only and 200 visual problems; in-house mathematical experts, Gradarius content staff and teaching academics review the selected material.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Table 4 reports o1 accuracy of 86.8% overall, 93.1% on 900 text-only problems and 58.5% on 200 visual problems; text-only and visual scores measure distinct subsets.
